stem:
The frequency table shows the results of a survey about how many days per week some families eat dessert.

Eating Dessert

| Number of Days | Frequency |
|---------------|------------|
| 0             | II         |
| 1             | III        |
| 2             | III        |
| 3             | II         |
| 4             | III        |
| 5             | III        |
| 6             | I          |
| 7             | I          |

Which dot plot represents the data in the table?
visual_elements: Frequency Table: Number of Days and Frequency with tally marks
Four dot plots labeled A, B, C, and D, each showing number of days 0 to 7 with dots above
difficulty_rationale: Student must translate tally marks to frequencies and match frequencies to the correct dot plot, requiring interpretation and comparison across multiple data representations.
notes: Frequencies were interpreted from tally marks; options are described verbally given the visual nature.
